confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Tenerife capital pricing for July 2026, not checked against live menus or listings. Restaurant and bar anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is seasonal and volatile in July. The FX value was taken from a search-tool summary citing the RBA exchange-rates page for 2026-10-15; I did not open that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Spanish coastal tourist cities and Canary Islands resort pricing, adjusted for Santa Cruz being the island capital, which is somewhat less tourist-priced than the southern resort areas. No cocktail or wine direct knowledge was strong enough to skip the beer relationship, so cocktail and wine were set at roughly 3.4x and 1.4x the beer anchor.
